requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: The referential ambiguity regarding the source of the rejection order is resolved using Business Rule BR-01 and the Glossary definition of Security Manager. The requirement is structured as a single functional requirement triggered by an external event.

source_fragments: When a rejection order is received for a cancellation request, System-A must raise a web alert.

fields.condition: a rejection order is received for a cancellation request

structured_requirements.final_statement: When a rejection order is received for a cancellation request, System-A must raise a web alert.
structuring_notes: Resolved referential ambiguity (AMB-01) by applying Business Rule BR-01 and Glossary definition. The 'rejection order' is interpreted as an order issued by the Security Manager.
